title: Azure AD Cross-Tenant Access Settings Deep Dive

chapters.title: Demo of inbound and outbound settings
Looking at the token for MFA property

description:
A look at the fantastic cross-tenant access settings capability. New controls for guest accounts both inbound and outbound and you can finally get rid of double MFA!

🔎 Looking for content on a particular topic? Search the channel. If I have something it will be there!
